bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
cd "$repo"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 71
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "sha256:58ae5730a1b9622acc5d34f635318dd39f0c45563b65ab59ee6b9f842f64cab1" || exit 72
git fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/fix/chat-three-topic-selector-20261114 >/dev/null
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 5e2e8b2903eade90aa46860e09dba4be50d5c0ff || exit 73
oldhash="$(sha256sum scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py | cut -d' ' -f1)"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
cp scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py "$tmp/original.py"
git show 5e2e8b2903eade90aa46860e09dba4be50d5c0ff:scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py > "$tmp/candidate.py"
python3 - "$tmp/original.py" "$tmp/candidate.py" "$tmp/updated.py" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import ast,re,sys
old=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
cand=Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text()
marker='            if action == "profile_button_smoke":'
begin='            if action in {"chat_selector_smoke", "invite_selector_smoke"}:'
assert old.count(marker)==1 and begin not in old
assert cand.count(marker)==1 and cand.count(begin)==1
start=cand.index(begin)
end=cand.index(marker,start)
block=cand[start:end]
assert 'latest.click' in block and 'get_messages' in block
assert 'log_out' not in block and 'sign_in' not in block and 'TelegramClient(' not in block
assert 'ACTIONS = frozenset({' in old
updated=re.sub(r'ACTIONS = frozenset\(\{([^}]*)\}\)',lambda m:'ACTIONS = frozenset({'+m.group(1).rstrip()+', "chat_selector_smoke", "invite_selector_smoke"})',old,count=1)
assert updated!=old
updated=updated.replace(marker,block+marker,1)
ast.parse(updated)
Path(sys.argv[3]).write_text(updated)
PY
python3 -m py_compile "$tmp/updated.py"
test "$(sha256sum scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$oldhash" || exit 74
cp "$tmp/updated.py" scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
chmod 600 scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
# Normal session-preserving code-activation restart; no separate Telegram client.
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service
sleep 3
if test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" != active;then
 cp "$tmp/original.py" scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
 echo "USERBOT_CODE_ACTIVATION=FAILED_SERVICE_INACTIVE"
 exit 80
fi
if ! timeout 35s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health >/dev/null 2>&1;then
 echo "USERBOT_CODE_ACTIVATION=AUTH_OR_IPC_NOT_VERIFIED"
 exit 81
fi
chat=FAIL
invite=FAIL
if timeout 65s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py chat_selector_smoke >/dev/null 2>&1;then chat=PASS;fi
if timeout 65s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py invite_selector_smoke >/dev/null 2>&1;then invite=PASS;fi
active="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
enabled="$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
{ echo "USERBOT_SELECTOR_LIVE_TEST";echo "CHAT_SELECTOR=$chat";echo "INVITE_COPY_SELECTOR=$invite";echo "USERBOT_ACTIVE=$active";echo "USERBOT_ENABLED=$enabled";echo "SOURCE_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)";echo "BOT_IMAGE=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"; } | gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
test "$chat" = PASS && test "$invite" = PASS && test "$active" = active && test "$enabled" = enabled
